Dispute
A Dispute refers to any disagreement or claim between the User and Spotify arising from various legal theories such as contract, tort, or statute.<SEP>A Dispute is a legal or contractual disagreement between the User and Spotify that requires resolution through informal or formal means.<SEP>A Dispute is a legal disagreement between a user and Spotify that is subject to resolution through arbitration or specific court venues.

Informal Resolution Period
The Informal Resolution Period is a mandatory sixty-day window during which parties attempt to resolve a dispute in good faith before proceeding to arbitration.<SEP>The Informal Resolution Period is a mandatory sixty-day timeframe during which the parties attempt to resolve a Dispute in good faith before proceeding to arbitration.<SEP>The Informal Resolution Period is the initial timeframe during which parties attempt to settle cases before they move into staged arbitration proceedings.

Notice
A Notice is a formal written document signed by a party that describes a dispute and must be sent before initiating arbitration.<SEP>A Notice is a formal document that specifies the nature of a Dispute, the basis of the claim, the harm suffered, and the relief sought.<SEP>A Notice is a formal document submitted by a claimant to initiate a dispute resolution process or notify parties of a claim.

Arbitration
Arbitration is a formal process for resolving disputes outside of the court system, administered by a third-party organization.

National Arbitration And Mediation
National Arbitration And Mediation (NAM) is the organization designated to administer arbitration proceedings between the User and Spotify.

Informal Settlement Conference
An Informal Settlement Conference is a meeting, typically held via telephone or video, intended to facilitate the resolution of a Dispute during the Informal Resolution Period.

NAM Rules
The NAM Rules are the procedural guidelines, including the Comprehensive Dispute Resolution Rules and the Supplemental Rules for Mass Arbitration Filings, that govern the arbitration process.<SEP>The NAM Rules are the governing standards used to determine the allocation and payment of Arbitration Fees, unless overridden by a court or specific agreement terms.

Federal Arbitration Act
The Federal Arbitration Act is the legislation that governs the interpretation and enforcement of the Arbitration Agreement.

Arbitration Agreement
The Arbitration Agreement is a specific section of the terms that outlines the mandatory process for resolving disputes through binding individual arbitration.<SEP>The Arbitration Agreement is the contractual provision outlining the terms and procedures for resolving disputes between the User and Spotify.<SEP>The Arbitration Agreement is a specific provision within the Terms that outlines the mandatory process for resolving legal disputes.<SEP>The Arbitration Agreement is a contract between Spotify and its users that outlines the procedures for cost-effective dispute resolution through arbitration.<SEP>The Arbitration Agreement is a legal framework within the Spotify Terms that mandates the resolution of disputes through individual arbitration.

Demand
A Demand is the formal application filed with NAM to officially initiate an arbitration proceeding.<SEP>A Demand is a formal request for arbitration filed by a claimant when a dispute cannot be resolved informally.

CT Corporation System
CT Corporation System is the registered agent for Spotify, located in New York, responsible for receiving service of process.

New York
New York is the designated city and state where federal or state courts have exclusive jurisdiction over non-arbitrable disputes.<SEP>New York is the city where Spotify's registered agent for service of process is located.<SEP>New York is the designated geographic location for court-based dispute resolution if the Arbitration Agreement is not enforceable.

Tolling Period
The Tolling Period is the timeframe during which statutes of limitations are paused while the parties engage in the informal resolution process.<SEP>The Tolling Period is the extension of time limits for legal claims while cases are held in a staged mass arbitration queue.

Arbitrator
An Arbitrator is a neutral third party with the authority to rule on disputes and award relief in individual arbitration proceedings.<SEP>An Arbitrator is a neutral third party who presides over arbitration hearings and has the authority to issue rulings and sanctions.<SEP>An Arbitrator is an independent official appointed to resolve disputes, issue reasoned written decisions, and make rulings on fee disagreements.<SEP>An Arbitrator is an individual appointed to hear and resolve cases within the individual or staged arbitration process.

Arbitration Fees
Arbitration Fees are the costs associated with filing, administration, case management, and hearings within the arbitration process.<SEP>Arbitration Fees are the costs associated with initiating and conducting an arbitration proceeding, governed by the NAM Rules.<SEP>Arbitration Fees are the costs assessed for filing and conducting arbitration proceedings, which are regulated by the staged arbitration process.

Federal Rule Of Civil Procedure 11
Federal Rule Of Civil Procedure 11 is a legal standard that ensures claims and requests for relief are not frivolous or brought for an improper purpose.

Court
A Court is a judicial body that may enjoin the filing of an arbitration or appoint an administrator if the parties cannot agree on one.<SEP>A Court is a judicial body that may enjoin improper arbitration filings or resolve disputes regarding whether claims qualify as part of a mass arbitration.

Counsel
Legal representatives who may represent the parties and participate in the Informal Settlement Conference and arbitration proceedings.<SEP>Counsel refers to the legal representatives for either the claimants or Spotify who coordinate the filing and management of mass arbitration cases.

Spotify Representative
An individual acting on behalf of Spotify who is required to personally participate in the Informal Settlement Conference.

Arbitration Administrator
The body responsible for managing the arbitration process; while NAM is the primary choice, another may be selected if NAM is unavailable.<SEP>The Arbitration Administrator is an entity responsible for managing arbitration proceedings, including fee reductions and deferred payments.

Comprehensive Dispute Resolution Rules And Procedures
A specific set of procedural rules provided by NAM that may govern the arbitration of a Dispute.

Federal Rule Of Civil Procedure 11(b)
The specific legal standard requiring counsel to certify that claims and relief sought are not frivolous or improper.

County Or Parish

data.content:
Federal Or State Courts Of New York
These are judicial bodies located in New York, New York, with exclusive jurisdiction over disputes not subject to arbitration.<SEP>These are specific courts in New York where disputes may be litigated if the Arbitration Agreement is invalidated.

State Law
The body of regional laws that, alongside federal law, authorizes an arbitrator to impose sanctions.

Federal Law
Federal Law consists of the national statutes of the United States that may preempt or influence the application of state laws.<SEP>The body of national laws that, alongside state law, authorizes an arbitrator to impose sanctions.

Terms
Terms refers to the legal agreement and conditions governing the relationship and service usage between Spotify and the user.<SEP>The Terms represent the overarching legal contract governing the relationship and obligations between Spotify and the User.

New York, New York
New York, New York is the designated geographic location for legal proceedings and court jurisdiction as specified in the agreement.

Jury Trial
A Jury Trial is a legal proceeding that both the User and Spotify explicitly agree to waive under the terms of the agreement.

Government Agencies
Government Agencies are federal, state, or local entities that may seek relief on behalf of parties regardless of the Arbitration Agreement.

Intellectual Property Rights
Intellectual Property Rights involve legal protections for creations of the mind, and disputes regarding their infringement are exceptions to mandatory arbitration.

Class Action Waiver
The Class Action Waiver is a legal provision requiring that claims be brought only in an individual capacity and not as part of a class or representative action.

U.S. Small Claims Court
A U.S. Small Claims Court is a legal venue where individual actions may be heard as an alternative to arbitration under specific conditions.<SEP>The U.S. Small Claims Court is a legal venue where parties may seek to resolve disputes if the Arbitration Agreement is found to be invalid.

Tounotice@spotify.com
The specific email address designated for receiving formal legal notices of disputes directed to Spotify.<SEP>Tounotice@spotify.com is the designated email address provided by Spotify for receiving individual notices from claimants wishing to opt out of arbitration.

Binding Individual Arbitration
A dispute resolution process where claims are decided by an arbitrator on an individual basis, excluding class or representative actions.

Spotify
Spotify is an organization and digital service provider that offers a comprehensive platform for music, podcasts, video, and audiobooks. As the primary entity responsible for the Spotify Service, the organization manages the distribution of diverse media content and establishes the fundamental framework for its use. Spotify maintains full ownership of its proprietary software and branding while holding specific licensing rights over user-generated content and feedback submitted to the platform.

In its capacity as a service provider, Spotify establishes the governing terms, guidelines, and conditions that define the legal relationship between the organization and its users. This role includes the management of subscription billing and the enforcement of the legal terms associated with the service. Spotify acts as a primary party to legal agreements, including those governing service terms and the resolution of potential disputes.

Spotify is a central party to the Arbitration Agreement and may initiate or be subject to various dispute resolution proceedings. Within this legal structure, the organization is responsible for specific procedural duties, such as the payment of mediator fees during global mediation in mass arbitration cases. Through these established frameworks, Spotify defines the legal processes for addressing grievances and maintains the regulatory standards for its global digital service.

User
A User is an individual who accesses and interacts with the Spotify Service, serving as a primary party to a formal legal agreement with the platform. To utilize the service, the User must agree to be bound by the Spotify Terms of Use, including all associated legal and platform-specific conditions. This contractual relationship establishes a set of rights and obligations for the User that remain in effect from the moment of agreement until the relationship is officially terminated.

As part of their interaction with the platform, a User is responsible for managing their subscriptions and must comply with all set legal requirements. The User is explicitly prohibited from assigning or sublicensing their rights under the agreement to any third parties. Furthermore, the legal framework governing the User's relationship with Spotify provides a structured dispute resolution process to address any conflicts that may arise during their use of the service.

Pre-arbitration Filing Requirements
Procedural steps, including the submission of a signed notice and account details, that must be completed before a party can initiate arbitration.

Mass Arbitrations
Arbitration proceedings involving multiple similar claims that are subject to specific enforcement rules and court oversight.

Public Injunctive Relief
A form of legal relief intended to benefit the general public, which may be subject to judicial determination regarding the scope of arbitration limitations.

Private Attorney General Action
A type of legal proceeding brought by a private party on behalf of the public, which is waived under the requirement to bring claims in an individual capacity.

Arbitrability
The legal determination of whether a specific dispute is subject to resolution through the arbitration process as defined by the agreement.

User Email Address
The email address associated with a user's Spotify account, designated for receiving formal legal notices from Spotify.

Sixty-Day Resolution Period
The mandatory time duration during which parties must attempt to resolve a dispute in good faith before proceeding to arbitration.

Spotify Service
The Spotify Service consists of personalized streaming music, videos, podcasts, audiobooks, and other content accessible via websites and software applications.<SEP>The digital platform and infrastructure through which users contribute content, interact with others, and access various media.<SEP>The Spotify Service is a digital platform for music and content that users access via accounts and subscriptions.<SEP>The Spotify Service is the platform and functional offering provided by Spotify for personal, non-commercial use of media content.<SEP>The Spotify Service is a digital platform provided to users, which is subject to termination or suspension based on compliance with its terms.<SEP>The Spotify Service is the platform and digital content provided by Spotify to its users.<SEP>The Spotify Service is the digital platform and associated offerings provided by Spotify to its users.

Spotify Terms
The Spotify Terms are the legal conditions and agreements that govern the use of the Spotify Service and the relationship between the provider and the user.<SEP>The Spotify Terms are the comprehensive terms and conditions that govern the use of the Spotify Service and the relationship between Spotify and its users.<SEP>The Spotify Terms encompass various guidelines, policies, and conditions including subscription terms, purchase terms, and card terms.

Mass Arbitration Section
The Mass Arbitration Section is a specific component of the Arbitration Agreement that outlines a staged process for managing numerous simultaneous arbitration claims.

Court Of Competent Jurisdiction
A Court Of Competent Jurisdiction is a legal authority empowered to enforce the Mass Arbitration Section and enjoin improper arbitration filings or fee assessments.

Spotify Paid Subscription Terms
The Spotify Paid Subscription Terms are specific conditions incorporated into the overall Spotify Terms that relate to paid services.<SEP>These are specific terms governing the use and payment of Spotify's paid subscription services.

Premium Subscribers
Premium Subscribers are individuals who pay for specific Spotify services and have rights regarding the acceptance or rejection of material changes to the Arbitration Agreement.

Spotify Privacy Policy
The Spotify Privacy Policy describes how personal data is collected, used, shared, and protected by Spotify.<SEP>The Spotify Privacy Policy is a document incorporated into the Spotify Terms that outlines the platform's data handling practices.<SEP>The Spotify Privacy Policy is a policy document that details how the organization handles user data and privacy.

Spotify User Guidelines
Specific rules that users must follow when posting content to ensure compliance with Spotify's legal and community standards.<SEP>Spotify User Guidelines are a set of rules established to maintain an enjoyable environment for all participants on the platform.<SEP>Spotify User Guidelines are a set of rules and standards that users must follow when using the Spotify Service and its content.<SEP>The Spotify User Guidelines are rules incorporated into the Spotify Terms that govern how users should behave while using the service.<SEP>A set of rules provided by Spotify to govern user conduct and platform usage.

Spotify Platform Rules
The Spotify Platform Rules are regulations governing the use of the Spotify platform, included as part of the overall terms.<SEP>A set of policies outlining the acceptable use and standard of conduct for the Spotify platform.

Staged Process
The Staged Process is a procedural framework for managing mass arbitrations in sequential batches of up to 200 cases to ensure efficiency and order.

Spotify Intellectual Property Policy
The Spotify Intellectual Property Policy is a document within the Spotify Terms that addresses rights and protections related to intellectual property.<SEP>A policy outlining the rules and protections regarding intellectual property on the Spotify platform.

Individual Arbitrations
Individual Arbitrations are legal proceedings where disputes are resolved on a case-by-case basis rather than through collective or class actions.

Agent

Opt-Out Notice

Spotify Notice Email

Attorney

Opt-Out Deadline

Class Proceeding

Content
Content refers to music, videos, podcasts, audiobooks, or other materials made available through the Spotify Service.<SEP>Content refers to the various media types, such as songs, videos, podcasts, and audiobooks, available through the Spotify Service.<SEP>Content refers to the digital media provided on the Spotify Service, such as music or other audio materials, owned by Content Owners.

Spotify Account
A Spotify Account is the personal portal through which users manage their profile, settings, and subscription status.<SEP>A Spotify account is a personal account required for a user to access the Spotify Service, tied to their country of residence.

Paid Subscription
A Paid Subscription is a recurring payment plan that provides continuous access to the Spotify Service until cancelled.<SEP>A Paid Subscription is a tier of the Spotify Service that requires payment of a fee for access, often on a recurring basis.

Prepaid Period

Spotify Brand Features

Audiobook Purchase Terms and Conditions
This document contains the specific legal terms governing the purchase of audiobooks outside of a subscription.

Platform Rules
A set of guidelines and policies governing user behavior and the moderation of content on the Spotify platform.<SEP>Platform Rules are regulatory documents that govern user behavior and content moderation on the Spotify Service.<SEP>Platform Rules are regulations that govern user behavior on the Spotify platform.

Audiobook Content

Codes

Spotify Card Terms

Customer Service Team
The Customer Service Team is the department at Spotify responsible for assisting users with account security and support.

Country Of Residence

Billing Information

Applicable Owners

Government Authorities

Trial

Agreements
The Agreements refer to the collective set of legal documents, including the Terms of Use and additional terms incorporated by reference, that govern the relationship between Spotify and the user.<SEP>The Agreements refers to the collective legal documents, including the Terms and User Guidelines, that govern the user's access to the Spotify Service.

Subscription Fee

Payment Method

Spotify USA Inc.

Tax Rates

Internet

Legal Guardian

Spotify Terms Of Use
The Spotify Terms of Use is a legal document that governs the access and use of the Spotify Service and its Content.

Mandatory Arbitration Provision
The Mandatory Arbitration Provision requires users to resolve disputes through individual arbitration rather than jury trials or class actions.

United States
The United States is the required country of residence for users accessing the Spotify Service under these specific terms.<SEP>The United States is a nation that maintains comprehensive trade and economic sanctions through several government departments.

Trials

Paid Subscriptions
Paid Subscriptions are Spotify Service options that require payment before they can be accessed.

Devices
Devices include personal computers, mobile handsets, tablets, wearable devices, and speakers used to access the Spotify Service.<SEP>Devices are the physical hardware used by individuals to access or interact with the Spotify Service.<SEP>Devices are the hardware units used to access the Spotify Service, which are subject to specific liability exclusions in the Terms.

Intellectual Property Policy
Guidelines provided by Spotify regarding the protection of intellectual property rights and the procedures for handling infringement claims.<SEP>The Intellectual Property Policy is a legal document referenced in the Spotify terms that outlines policies regarding intellectual property rights.

User Guidelines

Paid Subscription Terms

California Civil Code Section 1789.3

Spotify Customer Service

California Department Of Consumer Affairs
A government organization that includes a Complaint Assistance Unit for consumers to report issues under specific state codes.<SEP>The California Department Of Consumer Affairs is a government entity in California that oversees consumer protection and services.

Complaint Assistance Unit

California

Explicit Content Filtering Features

Spotify Software

Division Of Consumer Services
A division of the California Department of Consumer Affairs that houses the Complaint Assistance Unit.<SEP>The Division of Consumer Services is a branch of the California Department of Consumer Affairs mentioned in the contact instructions for consumer complaints.

User Content
Information, materials, messages, and other communications uploaded, created, or distributed by users through the Spotify Service.<SEP>User Content consists of information, messages, and materials that users post or upload to the Spotify Service.<SEP>User Content refers to any material or activity that a user posts, contributes, or engages in through the Spotify Service.<SEP>User Content consists of the material and information provided or uploaded to the Spotify Service by its users.

Content Owners

Malware

Customer Support
The department within Spotify responsible for addressing user queries related to accounts, payments, and service issues.<SEP>Customer Support refers to the resources and assistance provided by Spotify to help users manage their accounts and resolve service issues.

About Us

Implied Warranties

Telephone Number

Third-Party Providers

Service Provider Section
A specific section within the terms of service that provides Spotify's official mailing address.<SEP>The Service Provider section is a specific portion of the Spotify Terms containing the organization's mailing address.

Brand

Sanctioned Country

Trade Control Laws

Code

European Union

United Kingdom

Third Party
A Third Party is an external entity through which a user may sign up for a Paid Subscription or who may process payment method charges.<SEP>An external entity whose rights, such as intellectual property, must be respected by users posting on the service.

Regulation 2021/821

UK Export Control Act 2002
The UK Export Control Act 2002 is legislation in the United Kingdom that provides the legal framework for controlling exports and related activities.

Export Administration Regulations

UK Export Control Order 2008

Office Of Foreign Assets Control

U.S. Department Of Commerce

First Stage
The First Stage is the initial phase of mass arbitration where fifty selected cases proceed individually to arbitration.

Claimant
A Claimant is an individual or party who submits a Notice or Demand raising a claim against Spotify, often as part of a mass arbitration.

Mediator
A Mediator is a retired federal or state court judge who facilitates settlement discussions during global mediation sessions.

Process Arbitrator
A Process Arbitrator is a specialized official who resolves disputes specifically concerning the compliance with or applicability of mass arbitration procedural requirements.

Option One
Option One is a procedural choice that allows a claimant to opt out of arbitration and have their case heard in a court of competent jurisdiction after mediation fails.

Option Two
Option Two is a procedural choice where claims proceed through continuing staged arbitration if neither party elects to go to court.

Staged Proceedings
Staged Proceedings are a method used in mass arbitration to resolve large numbers of cases in sequential groups to ensure organizational efficiency.

Ruling
A Ruling is a formal decision or conclusion made by an arbitrator in a legal proceeding which may be considered in other arbitrations but is not binding on them.

Notice Of Intention To Opt Out
A Notice of Intention to Opt Out is a personally signed document a claimant must send to Spotify to formally withdraw from the arbitration process.

Device
The personal hardware, including its processor, bandwidth, and storage, used by a person to access and facilitate the operation of the Spotify Service.

Feedback
Ideas, suggestions, or other input provided by users regarding their experience with the Spotify Service or its content.

Community Terms
The legal terms and conditions that govern a user's participation in and use of the Spotify Community.

Spotify Users
Individuals who utilize the Spotify Service, contribute user content, and agree to the platform's terms of service.

Spotify Community
A digital space provided for discussions, tips, and the exchange of information related to the Spotify Service.

Understanding Recommendations On Spotify
A resource explaining how Spotify’s recommendation systems function and why certain content is displayed to users.

Business Partners
External commercial entities that collaborate with Spotify to provide advertising and other information to users.

Content Actions
An informational resource providing details on how Spotify moderates User Content and third-party content.

Safety & Privacy Center
A digital resource provided by Spotify where users can find information and tools related to safety and privacy.

Band
A musical group whose affiliation or endorsement cannot be falsely implied by users posting content on Spotify.

Label
A music industry entity whose affiliation or endorsement cannot be falsely implied by users.

Advertising
Promotional messages that may be integrated into specific types of content on Spotify, such as podcasts or shows.

Commercial Considerations
Factors, including business agreements, that may influence how content is selected and placed within the Spotify Service.

About Us Section
A part of the Spotify website that hosts Customer Support resources, contact information, and service details.

Moral Rights
Legal rights of an author, such as the right to be identified or object to derogatory treatment, which users agree to waive.
